programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina aiuta un ragazzo adottato in fuga che soffre di una rara malattia. Steve decide di interrompere le cure. Proust affronta il trauma dell’abbandono. Léo ufficializza il suo amore.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Durante una corsa benefica, Joana peggiora e sposa Steve in ospedale. Proust affronta finalmente sua madre. Nina rifiuta l’eredità e sceglie di restare infermiera. Ma un crollo allo stadio riporta l’emergenza.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Al primo giorno di tirocinio, Nina mette in dubbio la diagnosi del primario… che è anche il suo ex marito Costa. Il gesto riaccende tensioni in reparto e la rivalità con il dottor Proust.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina copre una giovane infermiera sorpresa con un chirurgo e viene creduta coinvolta. Quando un suo paziente cade in coma per un errore di dosaggio, Costa sorprende tutti difendendola.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Il padre di Nina viene ricoverato d’urgenza nel reparto che dirigeva. Restando al suo fianco, Nina assiste anche un uomo accusato di violenza domestica e si confronta con le proprie ferite familiari.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina si affeziona a una paziente obesa ignorata dal dottor Proust, mentre Léo si oppone a Costa per salvare una donna molto religiosa che rifiuta un intervento vitale.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Durante un’epidemia influenzale, Nina ritrova un’amica del liceo minacciata da paralisi. Intanto Léo cura un anziano diabetico deciso a sposarsi proprio il giorno in cui accusa un malore.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina affronta Proust per difendere un paziente terminale contrario alle cure invasive. Nel frattempo si teme una meningite per un altro ricoverato, mentre la vita privata di Costa complica tutto.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Dopo aver aiutato un parto in strada, Nina e Léo soccorrono madre e neonato in pericolo. In reparto però la caposala crolla sotto stress: malattia o burnout?

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Ultimo giorno di tirocinio: Nina attende il giudizio di Proust. La figlia Lily vive il suo primo stage in ospedale, mentre Léo affronta il ritorno dell’ex e segue un’atleta dai dolori misteriosi.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Un treno deraglia vicino all’ospedale. Nina assiste il macchinista, distrutto dal senso di colpa: depressione o causa medica? Léo segue una donna incinta di sei mesi mentre il marito lotta tra la vita e la morte in rianimazione.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Un militare amputato soffre di febbri misteriose e si avvicina a Léo. Nina cura una informatrice farmaceutica segretamente innamorata di Costa. Tra diagnosi difficili e sentimenti nascosti, il reparto è sotto pressione.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina scopre di essere incinta di Costa. Mentre riflette su come dirglielo, segue due adolescenti ricoverati per una sfida pericolosa. Léo assiste una donna iperprotetta dal marito e prova a proteggere la figlia dalla paura.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: La decisione sul bambino di Nina e Costa si complica. Una dirigente viene ricoverata per un “semplice” mal di schiena che nasconde un problema grave. Léo è sospesa e Nina segue due fratelli divisi da segreti e rancori.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Dopo un intervento, Nina torna al lavoro contro il parere dei medici. Nadine è in crisi e il reparto è teso. Intanto un adolescente con disturbi della crescita affascina Proust, ma il vero problema sono violente emicranie.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nadine è in coma e l’équipe è sconvolta. Proust si rifugia nel lavoro, deciso a salvare una paziente con SLA contro la sua volontà. Léo affronta un caso medico che divide Kevin e Costa su una diagnosi urgente.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Gelo tra Nina e Costa mentre arriva una nuova caposala. Nina segue una giovane con leucemia che potrebbe aver bisogno del midollo del fratellino. Léo assiste una donna segnata da aborti spontanei e un’embolia improvvisa.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Il reparto saluta Nadine. Nina cura un uomo senza fissa dimora e favorisce il ricongiungimento col figlio. Léo e Proust affrontano il caso di un padre accusato di simulare… finché una nuova diagnosi ribalta tutto.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Manrico propone a Giovanna una pausa, ma lei esita. Il commissariato affronta un sequestro con ricatto ai danni di un direttore di banca: la figlia è ostaggio. Intanto Paula torna nella vita di Mauro e reagisce male alla convivenza con Tiberio.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Il X Tuscolano indaga su un presunto rapimento nella comunità cinese: intercettazioni e pedinamenti coinvolgono tutta la squadra. Manrico e Mauro sorvegliano Laura per risalire a Saro. Luca prepara le dimissioni.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Il caso nella comunità cinese si complica: è una guerra tra famiglie mafiose con risvolti inquietanti. Luca e Valeria indagano su un abile truffatore porta a porta, mentre i colleghi pensano al regalo d’addio per Luca. Giovanna è provata dalla gravidanza.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Manrico e Valeria trovano in uno studio di posa il cadavere di un fotografo; paillettes rosse li portano a una giovane coppia, autori dell’omicidio per rubargli marijuana. Valeria si sente isolata e si confida con Giovanna. Si stringe il cerchio su Saro.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Sofia, giovane rumena aggredita, rivela un giro di matrimoni fittizi e un’organizzazione criminale. Intanto Giovanna incarica Valeria di avvicinare Laura, fidanzata di Saro: con uno stratagemma gli agenti arrestano l’attentatore della Scalise.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Una vicenda di gelosia finisce in tragedia: una ragazza, dopo aver ritirato la denuncia contro l’ex violento, viene uccisa; lui tenta il suicidio ma gli agenti lo fermano. Giovanna affronta Saro e tenta di farlo collaborare; senza prove, viene rilasciato.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Saro e Laura pensano alla fuga, poi Vito Tonnara uccide Saro davanti a Laura e riesce a fuggire. In commissariato, Laura identifica Tonnara. Intanto, Luca scopre un giro di lotte clandestine di cani. Paula accetta un lavoro a Milano e Mauro è furioso.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Pablo “il gitano” ottiene quattro giorni di permesso, ruba un'auto e la scambia per una pistola per rapinare una gioielleria. Intanto Tonnara, fuori controllo, vuole uccidere la Scalise. Parmesan scopre che il fidanzato di Vittoria è pregiudicato.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Mauro e Valeria scovano Pablo “il gitano”, che fugge ammanettando Mauro e prendendo un ostaggio. Dopo un inseguimento, la polizia lo cattura. Intanto Tonnara è a Roma. Ingargiola allontana il pregiudicato da Vittoria, gettandola nello sconforto.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Una coppia scoppia: lei denuncia il marito, sospettato di rubarle i gioielli. Roberto segue il caso e scopre che il ladro è sosia del suo migliore amico. Intanto Roberto e Angela preparano lo stesso regalo; Tonnara continua a spiare la Scalise.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Il professor Monti minaccia di gettarsi dal terrazzo. Angela tenta di salvarlo, ma un gesto inatteso la fa precipitare sotto gli occhi di Roberto e della figlia. Intanto, la minaccia contro la Scalise si acuisce: Tonnara la spia, armato di due pistole.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Paula arriva per l'ultimo saluto ad Angela, ma Mauro la respinge. Si scopre che l’avvocato Fabio Gregori è finito nel mirino di Pandolfi, che aveva perso una causa contro un suo cliente. Nel frattempo, Tonnara continua ad uccidere.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Roberto è segnato dalla morte di Angela. Paula lascia Mauro. Borsello tende un’imboscata a Tonnara, ma viene ucciso. Il boss irrompe al commissariato e ferisce Mauro; Giovanna gli spara e, poco dopo, entra in travaglio. Poi annuncia l’addio al Distretto.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Mentre Roberto Ardenzi è pronto a lasciare Roma per Bari, una rapina si trasforma nel sequestro di un autobus. Una misteriosa passeggera aiuta la polizia a salvare gli ostaggi: è Giulia Corsi, il nuovo commissario del X Tuscolano.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Il videoamatore Sergio Melis viene trovato morto. Una videocassetta rinvenuta in casa sua mostra immagini che riaprono il caso Angela Rivalta e fanno pensare a un omicidio anziché a un incidente.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: A fronte delle rivelazioni emerse dal filmato di Sergio Melis, Ardenzi decide di restare a Roma per indagare sulla morte di Angela. Intanto Giulia segue il caso di una donna vittima di violenza e cerca di convincerla a denunciare il suo aggressore.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Un adolescente si suicida. Si pensa che il gesto sia stato compiuto per le violenze sessuali subite da parte del proprietario di una sala giochi. Ardenzi cerca prove sul terrazzo dove è avvenuta la disgrazia riguardante la moglie.

programme.title: Video Killed The Radio Star: Artist View
programme.desc: Justin Hayward dei The Moody Blues e il regista Brian Grant parlano dei videoclip Your Wildest Dreams e I Know You’re Out There Somewhere.

programme.title: Video Killed The Radio Star: Artist View
programme.desc: Sammy Hagar, all’epoca nei Van Halen, e il regista Andy Morahan discutono dell’atteggiamento della band nei confronti della realizzazione dei propri videoclip musicali.

programme.title: Video Killed The Radio Star: Artist View
programme.desc: In questo episodio, Sebastian Bach e il regista Wayne Isham raccontano la loro collaborazione ai videoclip degli Skid Row, incluso il classico 18 and Life.

programme.title: Video Killed The Radio Star: Artist View
programme.desc: In questo episodio, Carol Decker dei T'Pau e il regista Brian Grant raccontano le idee dietro ai videoclip della band, incluso il suggestivo China in Your Hand.

programme.title: Video Killed The Radio Star: Artist View

programme.title: Video Killed The Radio Star: The Directors View

programme.desc: Video Killed the Radio Star ti porta dietro le quinte dei videoclip più iconici mai realizzati. Questo episodio racconta il lavoro pionieristico del regista David Mallet.

programme.desc: Video Killed the Radio Star ti porta dietro le quinte dei videoclip più iconici mai realizzati. Questo episodio presenta il lavoro del leggendario regista Andy Morahan.

programme.title: I Maestri del Cinema
programme.desc: Ha definito il suo stile unico di regia fin dai primi anni con Il Club dei 39 e Il pensionante, fino al glamour hollywoodiano di Intrigo internazionale e La finestra sul cortile, arrivando ai terrificanti Psyco e Gli uccelli.

programme.title: I Maestri del Cinema
programme.desc: Dalle commedie con Greta Garbo in Ninotchka, al classico noir La fiamma del peccato, fino ai suoi film premio Oscar Giorni perduti, Viale del tramonto e L’appartamento.

programme.title: I Maestri del Cinema
programme.desc: Gli esordi con Cary Grant in Susanna! e La signora del venerdì, poi i successi con Humphrey Bogart e Lauren Bacall in Acque del Sud e Il grande sonno, fino a Un dollaro d’onore con John Wayne.

programme.title: I Maestri del Cinema
programme.desc: Dirigendo i grandi Spencer Tracy e Katharine Hepburn in numerosi classici come La costola di Adamo e La matadora, e successivamente due musical iconici: È nata una stella e My Fair Lady.

programme.title: I Maestri del Cinema
programme.desc: Il regista duro, che da marine aveva assistito alle atrocità della guerra, divenne noto per le sue scene violente. È ricordato per I due violenti, Il mucchio selvaggio, Krigspiel – Il ferro e il sangue e Getaway!, e per aver reinventato il western.

programme.title: I Maestri del Cinema
programme.desc: Il regista di Accadde una notte con Clark Gable, dell’epico Orizzonte perduto con Ronald Colman e del classico natalizio americano La vita è meravigliosa.

programme.title: I Maestri del Cinema
programme.desc: John Huston scrisse molti dei film che diresse, gran parte dei quali sono oggi considerati dei classici: Il mistero del falco, Il tesoro della Sierra Madre, Il tesoro dell'Africa.

programme.title: I Maestri del Cinema
programme.desc: Kubrick è considerato uno dei più grandi e influenti registi della storia. Tra i suoi primi film: Rapina a mano armata e Il dottor Stranamore. Il capolavoro arriva nel 1968 con 2001: Odissea nello spazio, seguito da Arancia meccanica e Shining.

programme.title: I Maestri del Cinema
programme.desc: John Ford è noto per i suoi western visivamente potenti, con personaggi incorniciati nei paesaggi americani. Ombre rosse, 1939 e Sentieri selvaggi con John Wayne. Ha vinto 4 Oscar per la regia con Com’era verde la mia valle, Un uomo tranquillo e Furore.

programme.title: Frédéric Rossif - Il tempo e la memoria
programme.desc: Il documentario presenta la vita e l'opera del celebre regista francese Frederic Rossif, esplorando il suo talento nel creare film che uniscono arte, scienza e natura, e il suo ruolo nel portare sullo schermo storie di grande impatto e innovazione.

programme.title: Le stelle di Ouagadougou
programme.desc: Documentario sul FESPACO di Ouagadougou: trent’anni di cinema africano tra sogni, identità e lotta culturale. Registi e artisti riflettono su tradizione, mercato, futuro e sul cinema come voce vitale del continente.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 2, Episodio 3
programme.desc: È il 1958. Dopo una lunga giornata piena di lavoro, l'infermiera Jenny Lee trova la comunità della Nonnatus House radunata per augurarle buon compleanno.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 2, Episodio 4
programme.desc: Quando un neonato fatto nascere da lei muore all'improvviso, Cynthia viene indagata. Jimmy ricompare nella vita di Jenny con risultati sorprendenti.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 2, Episodio 5
programme.desc: Jenny viene assegnata al London Hospital. A Poplar, le levatrici conoscono una coppia di gemelle identiche molto schiette, di cui una incinta.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 2, Episodio 6
programme.desc: Dovendo gestire la nascita di un neonato disabile, Jenny dovrà appellarsi a tutte le sue abilità di levatrice. La Nonnatus House dovrà fare gli onori di casa a un'eccentrica conoscenza di Chummy.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 2, Episodio 7
programme.desc: La comunità di Poplar si riunisce per prepararsi alle festività estive. Dovendo allestire uno spettacolo per bambini, le levatrici sono più impegnate che mai!

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 2, Episodio 8
programme.desc: Il Dott.Turner riesce a far includere Poplar nel programma di screening a raggi X di massa per individuare i casi di tubercolosi. Intanto, Jenny incontra una famiglia devastata dalla malattia.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 2, Episodio 9
programme.desc: I turni di Cynthia nel quartiere la portano ad assistere il diabetico John Lacey, un deplorevole bulletto che umilia costantemente la moglie.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 2, Episodio 10
programme.desc: Chummy e Peter si preparano a diventare genitori. Fred riceve una visita dalla figlia Dolly, incinta. Nel frattempo, Suor Bernadette affronta i suoi difficili punti di svolta.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Special Christmas 2013: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Viene scoperta una bomba inesplosa. Questo fatto getta lo scompiglio tra le suore, le levatrici e tutti gli abitanti di Poplar proprio a pochi giorni dal Natale.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Special Christmas 2013: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Jenny Lee si ritrova risucchiata nella vita della giovane coppia formata da Yvonne e Alan Bridges, in attesa del primo figlio.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 3, Episodio 3
programme.desc: Suor Julienne riceve una telefonata dalla Prigione Holloway dove l'Esercito della Salvezza, che solitamente fornisce assistenza alle detenute, è stato decimato dall'influenza.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife
programme.desc: Jenny è preoccupata per una paziente ebrea, Leah, che cerca di far fronte alla malattia e all'agorafobia della madre invece di pensare alla sua gravidanza.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 3, Episodio 5
programme.desc: Una donna affetta da sindrome di Down viene condotta dalle levatrici e scopre di essere incinta, cosa che si traduce in una serie di confessioni e decisioni difficili.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 3, Episodio 6
programme.desc: Shelagh prende alcune decisioni importanti sul suo futuro, mentre Patsy trova difficile adattarsi alla caotica vita delle levatrici.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 3, Episodio 7
programme.desc: Cynthia è preoccupata per una neomamma, Pamela, che soffre d'ansia e, quando viene trovata con suo figlio sul bordo di un molo, tocca a Suor Julienne calmarla.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 3, Episodio 8
programme.desc: Mentre Chummy si prepara ad accudire in casa la madre morente, Jenny si ritrova ad aiutarla. Mentre Shelagh e il dottor Turner attendono notizie dal Centro Adozioni, la donna dà il massimo iscrivendo il suo coro a un concorso.

programme.title: Call the Midwife: Christmas Special: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Prove in corso per il Concerto della Scuola Domenicale!

programme.title: Andromeda: Vekten (del 1)
programme.desc: Dylan havner på Seefra, der den overtroiske befolkningen ikke har noen teknologi.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vekten (del 2)
programme.desc: Beka blir dumpet på Seefra etter at Andromeda er stjålet, og Dylan må bevise at skipet er hans.

programme.title: Andromeda: Phear Phactor Phenom
programme.desc: Likevel, på Seefra, finner Dylan Harper, som har tilpasset seg livet der.

programme.title: Andromeda: Engelenes forfall
programme.desc: Det viser seg at Doyle er en android bygget av Harper for å inneholde Rommies kjerneprogrammering.

programme.title: Andromeda: Eschatologi av vår nåtid
programme.desc: Beka vinner en pris fra en radio-DJ, lærer sannheten om Seefra og finner Meethus-diagrammet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Når går rundt ...
programme.desc: En forsker fra det opprinnelige Commonwealth dukker opp, fanget i en tidssløyfe.

programme.title: Andromeda: Forsøk på avrettingsmasse
programme.desc: Flavin kommer tilbake og utløser en gjengkrig og hjelper Dylan til å utvikle seg som et paradin.

programme.title: Andromeda: Så brenn de utemmede landene
programme.desc: En krystall som kan gjenopprette Andromedas kraft blir oppdaget, men for å få den, må Dylan jobbe for gruveeieren.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det som ikke var
programme.desc: Tunneler oppdages på Seefra som kan brukes til å nå åtte andre Seefra-planeter.

programme.title: Andromeda: Testen
programme.desc: Når en gammel mann blir drept, er Beka, Rhade og Harper de viktigste mistenkte og stilles for retten

programme.title: Andromeda: Gjennom et glass mørkt
programme.desc: Rhade leder opprørerne i en kamp mot en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stolthet før fallet
programme.desc: Dylan oppdager at kjæresten til Beka var Drago Musevini, og han brukte Bekas DNA til å skape Nietzscheans.

programme.title: Andromeda: Måneskinn blir deg
programme.desc: Beka og Rhade finner en test som enten gir dem stor rikdom eller driver dem til galskap.

programme.title: Andromeda: Fortiden er Prolix
programme.desc: Harper oppdager et program som kan ødelegge åtte av Seefra-planetene og drepe millioner.

programme.title: Andromeda: Motstandene av tiltrekning
programme.desc: Mens Harper jobber på en måte å redde Seefra-systemet, smyger en spion ombord Andromeda og angriper Beka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Sparer lys fra en svart sol
programme.desc: Det blir gjort et forsøk på å fikse den blinkende solen til Seefra, men Trance blir erstattet av en dobbeltganger.
programme.sub-title: Sparer lys fra en svart sol

programme.title: Andromeda: Total tilbakekalling
programme.desc: Når Dylan er hardt skadet i en laboratorieeksplosjon, reiser han gjennom en rekke alternative virkeligheter.

programme.title: Andromeda: Quantum Tractate Delirium
programme.desc: Rommie blir ombygd for å hjelpe til med å evakuere Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Andromeda: En dag til - Lys
programme.desc: En krigsherre overbeviser sine tilhengere om at den nærliggende ødeleggelsen av de ytre planetene er et komplott for å gjøre det lettere å plyndre planeten deres.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kaos og stillheten i det
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade og Beka jobber sammen for å redde Trance fra Methus-2 og Harper fra general Burma.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjertet av reisen (del 1)
programme.desc: Mannskapet gjør det endelig ut av Seefra-systemet og oppdager at Dylan er den siste Paradine.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bump in the Night
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his own bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside — physical evidence they hope will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Predator
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Haunted escape room at Moviescape - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to a haunted escape room attraction and although the sets are dressed to scare, something more sinister seems to be lurking here. Will Sean escape unscathed tonight?
programme.sub-title: Haunted escape room at Moviescape - Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Haunted escape room at Moviescape - Part 2
programme.desc: Sean continues his investigation of the escape rooms and investigates the haunted bible and radio. Prepare for a fright when Sean and Paul join forces and witness paranormal activity firsthand
programme.sub-title: Haunted escape room at Moviescape - Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Evil Spirit in the Cave
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension face a dark sinister ghost inside haunted Caves. Crank caves based in St Helens are said to be the most haunted in the area. Strange paranormal spirits spooky anyone that ventures inside.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: High Spirits at The Gothic Mansion
programme.desc: Bex and Sean investigate a haunting inside a gothic mansion, that is said to be haunted by the former owner of the building.
programme.sub-title: High Spirits at The Gothic Mansion

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Spirits Flying High at Speke Aerodrome
programme.desc: The team head to Speke Airport to investigate claims that some of the aircraft located there have ghostly passengers still aboard, waiting to take flight.
programme.sub-title: Spirits Flying High at Speke Aerodrome

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Block
programme.desc: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: WW2 Hospital Haunting
programme.desc: Built in the early 1900’s and now used as offices, a former world war hospital has become the new home for something supernatural. Strange voices, eerie footsteps and the sounds of painful screams have all been reported. What will be uncovered tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Man with a Cane
programme.desc: The team head to Bolton and investigate the Old Three Crowns. Haunted by the spirit of a very angry man with a deadly cane and an upset, young, ghostly girl, will they uncover why the girl is so upset? And could they encounter the angry spirit man?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Ghosts of Bolton Sea Cadets
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team heads to Bolton to check out the alleged haunting at Sea Cadets academy.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 1
programme.desc: Many urban explorers have encountered paranormal activity inside of the building, including child like figures, unexplained voices and strange knocking sounds. Will anything from the ghost dimension make contact?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 2
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate Norris Green Mansion. A 17th Century building, which is believed to hold some of the most haunted spirits in Liverpool. Will they make contact its ghostly entities tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 1
programme.desc: Bex and Sean are joined by a special guest as they investigate an abandoned home full of spirits in Liverpool.
programme.sub-title: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 2
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension encounter something paranormal in this exclusive unseen footage from their invetsigation of the Soul Less House in Liverpool.
programme.sub-title: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex begin their chilling investigation at the historic Clifton Hall Masonic Temple. Hidden behind closed doors for over a century, this sacred space holds more than just ritual secrets. They explore the eerie corridors and lodge rooms.
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Masonic Temple – Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The investigation continues as Bex and Sean split up to face the darkness alone inside Clifton Hall. From intelligent knocking and voices to the chilling sound of a child and unseen footsteps on the carpet.
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Masonic Temple – Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In a church reborn as a gym, something old still lingers in the shadows. Sean and Bex investigate Dream Body Gym inside the former Manor Church — where whispers echo through stairwells, music box melodies drift through empty rooms.
programme.sub-title: Haunted Strength – The Church Gym Investigation

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Deep in the woods on the outskirts of Liverpool lie the crumbling remains of a forgotten gatehouse — and the land surrounding it is said to be cursed. As Sean and Bex begin their nighttime investigation, unsettling activity begins to unfold.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex head to one of Leeds’ oldest public libraries, where the silence hides more than just books. Reports of shadow figures, unexplained voices, and a terrifying presence in the basement have kept rumours alive for decades.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In the first of a five-part investigation inside the historic Greenfield Valley Heritage Park, the team explores the eerie ruins of the old mills. Known for reports of ghostly children, unexplained footsteps, and phantom knocks on stone walls.
programme.sub-title: Greenfield Valley: Echoes of the Mill : Part 1

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: 16-Year-Old Surrogate Stole Our Baby
programme.desc: Sarah was Dawn and Derek's surrogate, but took off while five months pregnant. Sarah claims that they took advantage of her. Who are the baby's rightful parents?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: She's a Crazy Stalker
programme.desc: Victor met Jasmine a few years ago but claimed they never had sex. Jasmine claims that they fell in love and want him back! Who's telling the truth?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: These DNA Results Will Floor You
programme.desc: Joe met “Jessica” on a phone chat line. A few months later, she revealed she was pregnant. Then, Chastity claims that her ex Trent fathered her child. What will the DNA results reveal?
programme.sub-title: These DNA Results Will Floor You

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man
programme.desc: Chelse claims that her 19-month-old daughter is Malcolm's and that he beat her while pregnant. Amber and Phillip accuse each other of being abusive and want the polygraph tests to prove their claims!
programme.sub-title: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Slept Around: Who's the Dad?
programme.desc: Tasha wants to prove to her ex Martin that he fathered her four-year-old. Martin's sister says that the child might belong to her boyfriend Terrence. Who's the real father?
programme.sub-title: I Slept Around: Who's the Dad?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Bullied Out of School
programme.desc: Aabrea and Jerae bullied a high school girl so badly that she dropped out. Can Steve help them resolve their differences and figure out why so many teens turn to bullying?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Extreme Deception Indicated
programme.desc: Joe and Tammy have been together for six years and they have two children. Joe faces cheating accusations again and returns to Steve's stage for his lie detector results!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, I Think He's Gay
programme.desc: Monique’s friend claims that Adrian advertised himself on a “Gay for Pay” website. Then, pregnant Tyeasha suspects David of cheating on her with men. What will the polygraph say?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Wouldn't Wish This on Anybody
programme.desc: On today's Steve Wilkos, will the lie detector results reveal if Tamisha and Simone's men were faithful? Or will it reveal some more sinister results?
programme.sub-title: I Wouldn't Wish This on Anybody

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: The Devastating Truth
programme.desc: Desiaree refuses to believe her sister or mother's accusations against her father. Are their lies are keeping him in prison? Find out today!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Outraged!
programme.desc: Lagraciala tragically lost her ten month old son and cremated him, but after a serious fight with her fiancée AJ, she couldn't find the ashes. AJ admits to threatening to steal the ashes, but denies he took them!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Do Not Touch Her on My Stage
programme.desc: Scott and Dawn want their sister Betty to leave her boyfriend Michael because he's allegedly violent. The drama will explode when Scott confronts Michael on our stage today!
programme.sub-title: Do Not Touch Her on My Stage

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Shocking Statement
programme.desc: Today on Steve Wilkos, Vanessa reveals a secret she's been hiding from her boyfriend and Joel takes a DNA test to determine if he fathered Melissa's son!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Ever Have My Baby?
programme.desc: Since he never saw evidence of her pregnancy, Robert is here to find out if his ex-girlfriend Sara was ever pregnant with their child. What will his lie detector results reveal?
programme.sub-title: Did You Ever Have My Baby?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Chose the Molester Over Your Kids
programme.desc: Jackie’s family doesn't trust her boyfriend around her children, but she insists on staying with him. What horrible truth will Shaqualla's lie detector test reveal about her man?
programme.sub-title: You Chose the Molester Over Your Kids

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Do I Have a Child With a Gay Man?
programme.desc: Are Tracy and Latonia's men leading secret double lives with other men? What will the lie detector test results reveal about Kanecha and Mike?
programme.sub-title: Do I Have a Child With a Gay Man?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: DNA Shockers
programme.desc: Monique and Ashley find out who their newborn babies' fathers are on today's Steve Wilkos Show!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: This Should Be Explosive...
programme.desc: Katrina believes her sister Kendra’s boyfriend is a cheater and having sex with her best friend Nay-Nay! Later, John returns to the stage with a shocking update!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Do You Need a Medic or Are You Guilty?
programme.desc: Michelle needs answers about who hurt her daughter. She will stop at nothing to protect her baby. Will the father James clear his name on Steve's stage?
programme.sub-title: Do You Need a Medic or Are You Guilty?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: DNA: Don't Run From the Results
programme.desc: Roberta suspects that her husband Bryan has been cheating. They both believe the other is cheating. Find out whether these men are really the father on today's Steve Wilkos!
programme.sub-title: DNA: Don't Run From the Results

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: He Said Give Your Baby Away and You Did
programme.desc: Shannan claims Tim fathered her child. He doesn't buy it because he doesn't recall having sex with her! Later, Ayana is furious that her boyfriend Patrick denies their son!
programme.sub-title: He Said Give Your Baby Away and You Did

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This
programme.desc: Is Khadisa's boyfriend Chad cheating on her with her own sister? Will Maya's ex trust her and her current beau with their infant son?
programme.sub-title: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får overraskende en venn når Spencers søster Stephanie blir med i hennes moteklasse. Whitney tror den nye jobben er drømmejobben, men en hektisk tur til New York minner henne på å være forsiktig med hva hun ønsker seg.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: Lauren inviterer Stephanie i bursdagsselskapet sitt, men Heidi og Spencer sår tvil om Stephanies lojalitet. Spencer lanserer en plan for å vinne Heidi tilbake.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi prøver å bli venner med Audrina igjen, men Lauren har sine tvil om Heidis motiver. Whitney tilpasser seg den nye jobben, men oppdager fort at hun savner å jobbe med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi digger singellivet, helt til hun blir sjalu når hun ser Spencer sammen med andre jenter. Whitney ber om Laurens hjelp ved Moteuken i LA, og åpner dermed nye dører for Lauren og hennes karriere.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ute av bildet, prøver Heidi en siste gang å bli venner med Lauren igjen. Når Audrina begynner å være mer sammen med Heidi og Justin, spør Lauren seg selv om de egentlig bør fortsette å bo sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: En gammel flamme blusser opp når Stephen Coletti dukker opp igjen i Laurens liv. Heidi prøver å hindre Stephanie i å komme på Laurens innflytningsfest.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren havner mellom to stoler når spenningen mellom Lo og Audrina stiger. Heidi bestemmer seg for at forholdet til Spencer er over, og aksepterer et jobbtilbud som fører henne til Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I sesongfinalen føler Audrina seg utestengt av Laurens nære vennskap med Lo, og vurderer å flytte ut. Lauren gjør et inderlig forsøk på å reparere forholdet med Audrina, men det kan være for sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: Når sesong fire starter er situasjonen mellom Audrina og Lo anspent. Lauren forsøker å gjøre et godt inntrykk på en ny fyr, og et besøk fra Heidis søster Holly truer Spencer og Heidis forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie blir uvenner med broren sin og kompisen hans når Lauren møter på Spencer på bursdagen sin. Kelly Cutrone sparker noen på People's Revolution og Whitney fyller plassen. Laurens forhold med Doug kanskje går litt for fort fram.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren innser at kjemien hun hadde med Doug på videregående, ikke lenger er der. Whitney er nervøs for å dra til New York for jobben, men en date med en kjekk modell hjelper på humøret. Til tross for en fin gest vil Spencer bryte helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En heidundrende tur til Las Vegas går galt når Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody tar opp Stephanies fortid, og gutta ender opp i fengsel. Heidis søster Holly flytter inn, men det er lite Spencer heller vil enn å sparke henne ut.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kjemper for å redde vennskapet sitt, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fått nok av Heidis søster Holly og tar saken i egne hender. Og Brody og Doug forlater fengslet med noe nytt å fortelle.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tar kontakt med Lauren, noe som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til å revurdere hva som skjedde med vennskapet deres. Audrina og Justins forhold blir satt på prøve når hun jobber på en stor begivenhet for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Når Lauren drar på ferie med familien, ting går galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bak Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi blir venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sannheten om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer til slutt fram når de alle møtes på Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøk til LA og havner i en konfrontasjon med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi hvor hun beklager og innser at det er bare én ting som hindrer dem fra å bli venner igjen. Audrina starter å date en ny fyr for å gjøre Justin sjalu, men planen går feil.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møter sin gamle flamme Corey igjen og sjonglerer plutselig to gutter. Spencer tvinger Heidi til å sparke ut søsteren hennes Holly fra leiligheten.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina reiser til Cabo for Brody bursdag, men når Justin blir sjalu av Audrinas nye forhold, blir festen en slåsskamp. Spencer ydmyker Stephanie etter å funnet ut at hennes nye kjæreste er venn med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver å skape fred mellom Brody og Stephanie. Audrina ønsker å få ting til å fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke gi slipp på henne. Stephanie tviler på sin nye kjæreste etter at han bryter sitt løfte om å stå opp mot Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sitt eget sted, og håper at Justin vil flytte inn hos henne, men alle frykter at hun flytter av feil grunn. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med jobben, og blir tatt i å ha litt for mye moro.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney reiser til New York og den nye gutten Jay stjeler oppmerksomheten hennes. Heidi er nedfor etter å ha fått sparken, og da Spencer snakker med Brent for å få jobben hennes tilbake, gjør han bare situasjonen verre.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lar Heidis søster sove over hos seg. Justin ber Audrina med på tur for en romantisk helg, og Heidis frustrasjon med Spencer vokser etter at hun må tigge for å få jobben tilbake.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rykte hun hører: at Lauren har rotet med Justin. I mellomtiden prøver Holly å få Heidi bort fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøker å redde vennskapet med Lauren etter å ha anklaget henne for å rote med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøker bestemoren deres, som er lei av at de krangler.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney blir tilbudt drømmejobben i NYC og håper å få møte Jay der. Lauren blir nostalgisk da foreldrene selger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie ber Spencer om hjelp da hun ikke klarer å bestemme seg for hva hun skal gjøre med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer bekymringene til sine familier og stikker av til Mexico for å gifte seg. Whitney tar en sjanse på drømmejobben i New York City, og sier farvel til Lauren og sitt liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi møter på hverandre, og husker hvorfor de pleide å være venner. Spencer og Heidi har akkurat giftet seg da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin sjokkerer Audrina når han tar henne til Palm Springs for en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Når Heidi kommer til overraskelsesfesten på bursdagen til Lauren, gråter de to gamle vennene for vennskapet som har gått i oppløsning. Spencer starter en voldelig nevekamp når Cameron anklager ham for å ha plukket opp en bartender.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers sjarm fører Heidi hjem til Colorado, der gjenopptar hun kontakten med en gammel flamme. Lauren forteller Stephanie hva hun syns om at Heidi kom i bursdagsselskapet. Spencer snakker med Brody igjen etter en lang tids taushet.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Etter at Heidi tar Spencer på fersken på en nattklubb med bartenderen Stacie, krever hun at de skal gå i parterapi. Lauren setter ryktet sitt på spill når hun skaffer Stephanie en praktikantplass hos People's Revolution.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina forsøker å komme over Justin ved å kaste sitt blikk på Brody i stedet. Heidi sleper en motvillig Spencer til parterapi. Når Stephanie går i baret hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med å sparke henne.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Når jentene krasjer guttenes Hawaii tur, prøver Valeria å glemme Justin ved å flørte med Brordy. Heidis ekskjæreste, som er jomfru, kommer på besøk og Heidi håper at Spenser skal lære noe av eksens verdier.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrina fortviler når Brodys kjæreste konfronterer henne med Hawaii, og Brody gjør ingenting for å stoppe det. Heidi oppdager en tekstmelding fra Stacie til Spencer og drar til nattklubben for å konfrontere henne med det.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren er usikker på om hun skal gå i Heidis bryllup etter at Spencer endelig har bedt om unnskyldning. Brody nekter å risikere forholdet sitt til Jayde for å redde vennskapet med Audrina, og Stephanie konfronterer Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens siste episode må hun bestemme om hun er villig til å tilgi Spencer for å kunne stille opp for Heidi i hennes "prinsesse"-bryllup. Hele besetningen dukker opp og blir overrasket over en gjest ingen tenkte ville komme.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin starter krig når hun forsøker seg på Justin foran Audrina. Spencer og Heidi leter etter hus, og Spencer kjøper et hus uten Heidis godkjennelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Etter at Audrina ikke dukket opp, bestemmer Kristin seg for ikke å kjempe mot sine følelser for Justin. Heidi melder seg som barnevakt for naboen, men Spencer vil ikke ha noe med unger å gjøre.
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får smake på hvordan det er å ha et forhold til Justin når han ikke dukker opp på Brodys overraskelsesfest. Heidi og Spencer er uenige om når de skal starte familie, og Audrina dater Justins bestevenn.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror hun har temmet Justin, men kanskje er han fortsatt ikke over Audrina. Når Holly mister kontrollen på en tilstelning, er det Heidis jobb å få søsteren til å innrømme alkoholproblemet sitt.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin gjør seg kostbar med Kristin, men biter seg i halen. Hollys drikking fører til at Heidi og Stephanie må gripe inn. Brody og Jayde krangler slik at de må revurdere forholdet sitt.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin går på glør etter at Kristin og Audrina endelig møtes ansikt til ansikt. Alt Heidi ønsker seg til bursdag er en baby, men Spencer har helt andre planer.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Un-Bear-Able
programme.desc: Murrays tvilsomme fortid avsløres endelig. Husets sterkeste og rareste par konfronterer sitt første eks-hinder. Janelle får se konsekvensene av sine handlinger.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: How to Keep a Man 101
programme.desc: Chad og Nicoles situasjon forverrer seg når en annen eks kommer og tilfører dramaet kaos. En hjemmefest gjør en annen eks kjempesjalu.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ghost of Relationship's Past
programme.desc: Nicole blir sjalu når Maddie sier noe skandaløst. Et gjenferd fra gamle forhold kommer for å ta havn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Bad Bromance
programme.desc: Angelas verste mareritt blir sant da et eks skylles opp på stranden. Chad håndterer konsekvensen av Nicoles handlinger. En skvett truer med å bryte husets sterkeste bromace.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex-Viction Notice
programme.desc: Shack of Secrets lander på to uheldige omstendigheter. Angela må svare for seg og Nurys må fatte en viktig avgjørelse. Eksene står overfor en overraskende eliminasjon.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex, Lies, and Polygraph Tape
programme.desc: Farrah er tilbake og finner en gang for alle ut at hun har kommet over eksen. Sannheten avsløres da en løgndetektor-test tvinger huset til å ta en ærlig titt på forholdene sine.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Del 1
programme.desc: Etter en turbulent sesong, gjenforenes sigler og ekser for første gang for et oppkok av de største forbindelsene, bruddene og bedragene. Ensemblet avslører om de stadig er forelsket, eller valgte å si til helvete med den da sesongen sluttet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Del 2
programme.desc: Dramatikken fortsetter i den overraskende del 2 i Ex on the Beach Reunion. Løgndetektoren tvinger Morgan til å innrømme sannheten. En helt ny forbindelse avsløres og utroskaps skandaler avdekkes.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Welcome to the Peak
programme.desc: Ti realitekjendiser ankommer vinterlandskapet for å se om de kan finne sin neste for minglesesongen. Hva de ikke vet er at eksene deres kommer til å styrte inn som et snøskred.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Winter Un-Wonderland
programme.desc: Eksene til Callum og Nicole forårsaker skikkelig trøbbel i huset. En kjærlighetsforbindelse oppstår for et par og brytes raskt for et annet. En ny eks ankommer og den første 'Hot Date' blir belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Caught Red Velvet Handed
programme.desc: Daniel gjør et klossete forsøk på en kjærlighetsforbindelse. Varmen stiger i "Sauna of Secrets" for en utro singel. Den første eksen ises ut av sommrhuset.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex
programme.desc: Marlon får mange eksers oppmerksomhet og Adore er mindre glad for det. En sjarmerende overraskelse avbryter "the Hot Date".
programme.sub-title: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Boo Years Eve!
programme.desc: "Sauna of Secrets" avslører et mysterie for Marlons eks. To singler slåss om den samme eksen. Tingene går varme under Ice Ceremony når en eks foretar et overraskende trekk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: The Bird Has Landed
programme.desc: Georgia og Callums forhold settes på prøve når den eksen de frykter mest dukker opp. Spenningen gnistrer over La Demis siste kjærlighet. En romantisk Hot Date blir belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: SOS, Save Our Singles
programme.desc: En sjokkerende "Sauna of Secrets" betyr at singlene må passe seg under "Ice Ceremony". Allie og Nialls av og på-forhold gjør at Allie havner på gyngende grunn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Ex-Cuzzi
programme.desc: En perfekt date blir til et perfekt mareritt for et par. Niall får seriøs konkurranse om Allies hengivenhet. Marlon og La Demi kjemper for å finne ut av situasjon-forholdet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Mums the Word
programme.desc: Georgia og Callum møter sine verste kritikere. Marlon fanges mellom en stein og en varmt sted da en eks som eventyrer forholdet hansmed La Demi ankommer. Ice Ceremony tar en uventet vri.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Don't Say Soulmate
programme.desc: Når en første kjørlighet ankommer the Peak, kastes de gyldne parene inn i en loop. En ny forbindelse og et overraskende valg under "Hot Date" får Tyranny til å se rødt.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Adore-able Mess
programme.desc: Adores besøk på "Sauna of Secrets" setter romansen med Tyler på spill. En ny eks innebærer en velkommen distraksjon. La Demis innstilling til eksen sin, får bestevennen hennes til å vende seg mot henne under Ice Ceremony.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Breaking Winter Balls
programme.desc: Adore presses til å velge mellom eksen og sin neste, og presser en av dem i et sjalusiutbrudd. En heit date blir belønnet, noe som får spenningen til å gnistre og gir noen hjertesorg.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Liar, Liar, Chalet on Fire
programme.desc: En sjokkerende løgndetektortest gjør hele huset rasende, og et sterkt par mister troen på forholdet sitt. Endelig får Georgia vite sannheten om Callum og Paris.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Say Yes to the Next
