programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ghost in the Machine
programme.desc: While investigating the apparent overdose suicide of Reverend Bill Guthrie's wife, detectives recover incriminating files from Bill's computer and learn of his infidelity.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Touching Recollection
programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Suspect
programme.desc: The wife of a respected police officer was murdered in her own home. The crime went unsolved for more than a decade, until a newly formed cold case unit took a fresh look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sip of Sins
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a trio of unsolved murders occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas. Later, a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with far more than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Partners in Crime
programme.desc: In a 1992 murder case, the autopsy of a cremated body turns up telltale clues of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Music Case
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her Minnesota home. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: If I Were You
programme.desc: Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nursery Crimes
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Internal Affair
programme.desc: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: The doctors at the hospital couldn't determine the cause of Bobby Curley's hallucinations and intense pain. They treated it as a neurological disorder but his condition deteriorated. He was being poisoned.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980's the federal penitentiary in Atlanta held some of the country's most notorious prisoners. Castro called them undesirables. The U.S. government called them detainees. In 1987 they staged a bloody revolt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game

programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction

programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.
programme.sub-title: Shooting Gallery: Asteroids and Comets / Galactic Visions: Alien Worlds

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System

programme.desc: Singlerne og ekserne mødes for første gang siden den sidste ceremoni. Værterne Ashley Iaconetti og Jared Haibon fortæller os, hvilke par stadig er i hvedebrødsfasen, hvem der har slået op og hvem der har fundet sammen med deres eks igen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: War of Words
programme.desc: 'Ex on the Beach' er tilbage med otte singler, som håber at finde kærligheden på Bali, men i stedet erklærer Fatima og Nicole krig. Marty bliver betaget af Fatima, og Che og Max kan lide hinanden, men holder det, når eksene kommer?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: A Geordie Reunion
programme.desc: Jagten på kærlighed fortsætter, men problemer opstår, da Chloe fra 'Geordie Shore' afslører sine følelser for Marty. Jordan bliver aggressiv over for alle, og striden mellem Nicole og Fatima når et dramatisk klimaks.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Clash Of The Titans
programme.desc: En supersexet eks ankommer og skaber drama. Jordan er ude efter Chloe, og da Marty søger trøst hos en anden, bliver der et Geordie-opgør.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Max Makes His Move
programme.desc: Følelserne raser i villaen, da Chloe gør Marty rasende, Max og Georgias kærlighed blusser op igen, og Dean har planer for Che, men vil en ekskæreste ødelægge det for ham?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Ex Rated
programme.desc: Ankomsten af to nye ekser skaber ravage i huset. Georgie leger med Max' følelser. Chloe og Martys forhold sættes på prøve, da han afslører sin pikante lille hemmelighed.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Actions Speak Louder Than Words
programme.desc: Terrortabletten skaber kaos på stranden, da Stevie skal vælge, hvem der skal hjem. Chloe vil have fysisk opmærksomhed fra Sam, og Brads nye kærlighedsforhold gør ham vildt lykkelig.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Fight For Georgia
programme.desc: Chloe og Sams forhold er som en rutsjebane. Max bliver træt af Stevie og finder noget sjovere et andet sted. Ankomsten af en ny eks får Georgia og Brad til at flippe skråt.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Marty The Meddler
programme.desc: Kløerne kommer frem, da gruppen tager på en vild safari og Deans alfahanstatus bliver truet. Marty blander sig i Chloe og Sams forhold, og John har hænderne fulde med Georgia.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Love Is In The Air
programme.desc: Terrortabletten virker ikke, som den skal, og sender Marty på en date med Sam. En ny gæst sender tvillingerne ud i kamp, og John, mens Georgias forhold vokser sig stærkere og stærkere.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: #Ballininbalifinale
programme.desc: Bali-strandfesten får en dramatisk slutning, når den sidste nyankomne skaber kaos i villaen. Georgia og John klarer ikke den sidste forhindring, og Chloe får endelig det, hun vil have af Sam.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Journey To Engagement
programme.desc: Seks par og deres eks'er skal fri eller gå hver til sit. Men før de siger ja, er de så ovre eks'en?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You're Breaking My Heart
programme.desc: Parrene finder sig til rette i villaen, men ferien er slut, da de første ekser tjekker ind. Liam finder ud af den hjerteskærende sandhed om Leylah og hendes eks. Vi afslører nogle øjenåbnende sandheder og byder nogle surprise-gæster velkommen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Secrets Of The Past
programme.desc: The Shack byder flere ekser velkommen i villaen, der truer parrenes tid i paradis. Sorinn og Lola har et eksplosivt skænderi ved middagen. En eks' ankomst volder problemer for et par, da en hemmelig forlovelse afsløres.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Hitting Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Kamie tager parrene ud af villaen for at springe ud i det. Spari og Shaylas forhold tilsyneladende perfekte forhold rammer bunden. Et spil sandhed eller konsekvens kører af sporet, da Jamie kritiserer Thailah foran hele villaen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: We Need This Time Apart
programme.desc: Kamie leverer chokerende nyheder, da parrene begynder fase 2 af deres rejse mod forlovelsen. Sorinns tvivlsomme tilgang til at redde sit forhold til Lola kan bringe det til en ende. Leylahs kærlighedstrekant får hende til at føle sig ikke-respekteret.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Can Love You Better
programme.desc: Partnerne flytter ud af villaen og efterlader ekserne alene til at arbejde sig igennem deres problemer. En tur til skuret tvinger partnerne til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, om de har det bedre med deres ekser. Samura udløser et eksplosivt skænderi.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: I dette afsnit pimper teamet Krissys Volkswagen Baja Bug. Med et slidt udstædningsrør og smadrede døre er hendes bil langt fra i tiptop stand.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: I dette afsnit pimper teamet Brians Honda CRX. Det er den første bil, der får en ny motor fordi den gamle motor dør før Xzibit kan få bilen hen på værkstedet.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: Gaby ejer intet andet end sin yogamåtte og en 1972 Land Cruiser, som hun købte af sin eks for 200 dollar. Drengene begynder med det ydre...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: I dette afsnit pimper teamet Kerrys Ford Escort. Bilen består af to halvdele af to forskellige Ford Escorts, der er blevet svejset og "klistret" sammen. Teamet mener, den er for farlig at køre rundt i...

programme.title: Are You The One?: Jelly AF
programme.desc: Der bliver kaos i huset, da Kareems tiltrækning af Zoe får Alivia til at bryde ud i gråd. Alles nerver er på højkant, da pigerne vælger at følge en strategi til parceremonien.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Don't Come at Me Crazy
programme.desc: Jada bliver rasende, da Uche angriber hende for at lægge an på Clinton. To 'on-off'-par finder sammen igen. Pigernes familier afslører pinlige oplysninger.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Sinking Relation-ships
programme.desc: Nurys kan ikke klare, at Malcolm og Diandra finder sammen. Huset er splittet mellem par, der nægter at splitte op, og singler, der har svært ved at knytte bånd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tra Cray
programme.desc: Kareem og Alexis presses til bristepunktet, da Alivia og Keith udforsker, om de er et perfekt par. Ekser kommer med afsløringer, inklusive en eks, der allerede ved besked.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players
programme.desc: Audrey bliver paranoid, da hun ser Michael skabe kontakt til Geles. Malcolm får ballade, fordi han er en player, og huset begynder at udforske nye forbindelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: No Love in Nola
programme.desc: Jalousi kommer i centrum til en vild Mardi Gras-fest. Geles bliver fjende nummer et, da hun bager på flere fyre i huset. Dimitri provokerer Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler vil gerne ud af venneboblen med Nicole. Shad viser nogle følelser. Der er knuste hjerter og jalousi i huset, og de beder Keith om at finde en vinderstrategi.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Den sidste parceremoni nærmer sig hastigt, så huset er desperat for at få de rigtige par ind i sandhedsbåsen og finde de 11 rigtige par. Keith og Alexis presser hinanden lige til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One
programme.desc: Vært Terrence J giver os et eksklusivt kig på denne sæsons medvirkende i AYTO og afslører, hvorfor de 22 singler er elendige til forhold.
programme.sub-title: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 1
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 2
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Leap of Fate
programme.desc: 22 singler tager springet og flytter ind i et hus på Hawaii for at prøve at finde 11 perfekte par og vinde en million dollar. Jalousi spreder sig, når par dannes hurtigt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Flirt at Your Own Risk
programme.desc: Zak provokerer Bria, når han flirter med andre kvinder, og hele huset bliver inddraget i dramaet. Tevin og Kenyas letsindige opførsel truer deres spirande forhold.

programme.title: Are You The One?: With Frenemies Like These...
programme.desc: Zak udforsker sine muligheder, mens kvinderne slås om hans opmærksomhed. Kenya og Jasmine bliver officielt fjender.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name
programme.desc: Asia bliver såret, når hun finder ud af, hvad hendes ven og fyren, hun er vild med, gjorde bag hendes ryg. Cali og Bretts spirende romance bringes i fare af deres dårlige vaner.
programme.sub-title: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tracurricular Activities
programme.desc: Huset bliver rystet, da deres ekser dukker op for at få noget kvalitetstid. Bølgerne går højt, når en eks truer med at splitte et stærkt par ad. Zak er splittet mellem Bria og Morgan.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Spilling The Tea
programme.desc: Kwasi starter drama, da han afslører, hvad Tevin og Jasmine gjorde natten før. Bria bliver sur over Morgan og Zaks forhold. Huset tager nogle risikable parvalg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: He Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Cam begynder at tvivle på sit forhold til Kayla. Daniels små lege skubber Sam væk. Huset oplever deres vigtigste sandhedsbås indtil nu.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beast Mode
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt mellem Cam og Kwasi, da Kwasi lægger an på Kayla. Asia eksploderer, da hun tror, at nogle folk i huset er falske. Zak må træffe et valg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I Want You To Want Me
programme.desc: Nutsa er vild med Brett, men det får konsekvenser for hele huset, at Brett ikke kan glemme Cali. Moe bliver presset til at spille spillet, og Lewis afslører sine sande følelser for Asia.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Want Me

programme.title: Are You The One?: Master Plan
programme.desc: Brias besættelse af Zak truer husets evne til at spille spillet. Cali finder på en plan, der skal afsløre, hvilke magtpar, der er perfekte sammen, og hvem der ikke er.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time
programme.desc: Til en vild fest gør tvivlsom opførsel bedste venner til fjender. Tevin og Kenya gør sig klar til at få opklaret deres skæbne. Moe bliver presset til at tage sig sammen.
programme.sub-title: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Baseret på Richard Yates' bestseller følger denne fængslende og gribende historie om et lidenskabeligt, ungt par i forstads-Connecticut, som bestemmer sig for at risikere alt og følge deres drømme.

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: The Cider House Rules
programme.desc: Den Oscar®-vindende publikumsfavorit om en mand, der søger efter et tilhørssted. Filmatiseret af bestsellerromanen, John Irvings stærke lektion om livet, kærlighed og hjemmet fik ros af kritikere og biografgæster over alt.

programme.title: Lars and The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom er en elskelig indadvendt mand, hvis emotionelle bagage har afholdt ham fra at udforske livet. Efter flere års ensomhed inviterer han Bianca, en ven han har mødt på internettet. Han introducerer Bianca for sin bror, Gus og hans kone, Karen.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: I 1900-tallets Paris presses Colette af sin mand til at skrive bøger i hans navn. Da bøgerne bliver en succes, forråder han hende, og hun må kæmpe for at få en stemme i en mandsdomineret forfatterverden samt den anerkendelse, som hun fortjener.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Baseret på den sande historie om fire udenforstående, der så, hvad de store banker, medierne og regeringen nægtede at se, det globale økonomiske kollaps.

programme.title: The Immigrant
programme.desc: New York, 1921. Den polske kvinde Ewa sejler til Amerika i jagten på et nyt liv. Her møder hun den charmerende, men ondskabsfulde mand Bruno, der presser hende ud i prostitution. Men tryllekunstneren Orlando kan blive hendes håb og redning fra Bruno.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Betrayed
programme.desc: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A kidnapping can shatter a family, bringing terror and heartache without warning. In 1984 with the flash of a gun, an ordinary business transaction became a violent abduction. In seconds, the son of a wealthy Miami developer was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a bank teller arrived at her parent's home the gunmen were already there. The robbers held her family hostage and forced her to empty a bank vault. If she didn't comply she could lose everyone she loved.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When gangs go to war, they don't care who gets in the way. In 1988 an innocent man was gunned down near Cleveland, Ohio, a victim of a deadly initiation.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: While camping with her family in Montana, a seven-year-old girl was abducted from her tent. No one in the campground witnessed the crime and the kidnapper left no clues.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a paramilitary faction used bombs and robbery to further their cause, they crossed the line. The well-organized terror cell was difficult to define, and even harder to stop.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1992, a woman disappeared from her Memphis home. When the ransom went uncollected, the FBI suspected a desperate amateur and feared the worst.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Næsten 20 år efter, at TV-kultserien Galaxy Quest blev stoppet, beder en race af rumvæsner holdet fra serien om hjælp til at redde universet.

programme.title: The Rules of engagement
programme.desc: Oberst Terry Childers (Samuel L. Jackson) er en elitesoldat med en pletfri karriere, indtil en rutineoperation i Yemen ender i en katastrofe. Demonstranter foran den amerikanske ambassade går amok og åbner ild.

programme.title: Big Kill
programme.desc: Jim Andrews tager til byen Big Kill for at slutte sig til sin bror. Undervejs møder han to mænd eftersøgt af den mexicanske hær og hyrer dem til at vejlede og beskytte ham. Når de først er der, står de ansigt til ansigt med en truende prædikant.

programme.title: Demain tout commence
programme.desc: Samuel nyder et sorgløst liv på Den Franske Riviera, indtil Kristin, som han har haft en kortvarig affære med, meddeler, at han er far til et nyfødt barn, overlader en lille pige til ham og stikker af!

programme.title: Ernest Goes to School
programme.desc: Jim Varneys tilbagevendende tumpede karakter Ernest P. Worrell vender tilbage i denne film som en pedel, der prøver at komme igennem high school. Bemærk denne film vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: Den muntre, romantiske komedie Ghost Town er historien om Bertram Pincus, en vred tandlæge fra Manhattan, der udvikler en uønsket evne til at se afdøde mennesker.

programme.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
programme.desc: It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: 1941, syv krigsfanger flygter fra den frygtelige sovjetisk Gulag-lejr. Igennem 11 måneder kæmper de sig over 6.500 km fra Sibirien over den glohede Gobi-ørken i Mongoliet og videre over Himalaya bjergene.
En kræftpatient (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) overvinder alle odds med hjælp fra sin bedste ven (Seth Rogen), sin mor (Anjelica Huston) og en ung terapeut (Anna Kendrick).

programme.title: The Kids Are All Right
programme.desc: the kids are all right Det lesbiske ægtepar Nic og Jules havde den perfekte familie. Men de får sig et chok, da husets to teenagebørn opsøger den sæddonor, der er deres biologiske far. En øko-hippie ved navn Paul. En ren feel-good komedie.

programme.title: Præsidentkandidaten
programme.desc: En mand slutter sig til den politiske kampagne for en snu kandidat til præsident i USA.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Moors Murders
programme.desc: An investigation into the Moors Murderers, Myra Hindley and Ian Brady, with interviews with the family of Keith Bennett.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Suzy Lamplugh
programme.desc: A look at the case of estate agent Suzy Lamplugh, who showed a client around a house in Fulham in July 1986 and was never seen again. Dermot Murnaghan hosts.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Wrongly Released
programme.desc: This special episode shines a light on criminals who have been brought to justice for one crime only to be released to commit further terrible acts.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Rochdale Groomers
programme.desc: Rochdale Groomers: Documentary examining the sex abuse scandal which occurred in the North of England and appeared to go undetected for quite some time.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Joanne Dennehy
programme.desc: Dermot Murnaghan returns to uncover the truth behind the horrific crimes of Peterborough serial killer Joanna Dennehy.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Keith Blakelock
programme.desc: In 1985, PC Keith Blakelock was murdered during a riot on a housing estate in London, triggered after a black woman died of heart failure during a house search. Nobody has been brought to justice for his murder, despite three investigations.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Peter Tobin
programme.desc: Peter Tobin is one of the most notorious serial killers in the UK. From 1991–2006 he raped and murdered three young girls; Dinah McNicol, Vicky Hamilton and Angelika Kluk. Yet even prior to these horrific murders he had a history of violence.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: John Sweeney
programme.desc: John Sweeney brutally murdered two of his girlfriends, dismembered their bodies and dumped them in canals. In a macabre twist, he hid clues in his abstract paintings, and five other girlfriends of his are currently still missing.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Manchester
programme.desc: The series returns to take a closer look at the most horrific crimes ever committed on British soil, starting with the May 2017 Manchester Arena bombing.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Ann Maguire
programme.desc: The tragic story of Ann Maguire, who was stabbed to death by a teenage pupil while teaching a Spanish lesson at Corpus Christi Catholic College in Leeds.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Gemma McCluskie
programme.desc: The harrowing story of EastEnders actress Gemma McCluskie, who was murdered by her older brother in the flat they shared in east London in 2012.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Stepping Hill
programme.desc: An inside look at the series of mysterious deaths that occurred at Stepping Hill Hospital in Stockport, Greater Manchester, in 2011.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Steven Wright
programme.desc: A closer look at the crimes of Steve Wright, who was dubbed 'The Suffolk Strangler' after murdering five women who worked as prostitutes in Ipswich in 2006.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Stephen Port
programme.desc: A chilling look at the crimes of Stephen Port, the east London serial killer who poisoned four young men with lethal doses of a date rape drug.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: Examining the case of a man who murdered his wife after she allegedly admitted to an affair.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A man murders his estranged wife's lover after confronting the couple in an Edmonton parking lot.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A woman pleads self-defense in the stabbing death of her allegedly abusive husband.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A financier lives after his socialite wife shoots him six times in their Calgary condo.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A woman shoots her allegedly abusive husband in his sleep.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A woman shoots her abusive common-law husband after he leaves her and their two children for another woman.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: Explore the case of an abused California woman who killed her husband is examined.

programme.desc: A woman claims she shot the man she loved in self-defense.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Avatar Day
programme.desc: Aang must clear up a wave of anti-Avatar sentiment and atone for something he did in the past.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blind Bandit
programme.desc: In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament where they encounter Toph, a blind, but powerful Earthbender.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Zuko Alone
programme.desc: Traveling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bitter Work
programme.desc: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher. Meanwhile, Sokka gets himself in a jam.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Library
programme.desc: A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Desert
programme.desc: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Uncle and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Serpent's Pass
programme.desc: The group then huddles around the map to discuss in which direction they should go - the Serpent's Pass appears to be the most direct route.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Drill
programme.desc: Aang discovers a secret Fire Nation super weapon heading straight for Ba Sing Se and must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: City of Walls and Secrets
programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them. Meanwhile, Jet tries to find proof that Zuko and Uncle are Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Tales of Ba Sing Se
programme.desc: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Uncle, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Appa's Lost Days
programme.desc: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen, and find out exactly what happened to him, and where's he's been all this time - and where he is now!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Lake Laogai
programme.desc: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Earth King
programme.desc: The kids battle Long Feng the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Guru
programme.desc: Aang starts to learn control of the Avatar State from Guru Pathik at the Eastern Air Temple. Sokka is reunited with his father.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Crossroads of Destiny
programme.desc: When Aang has a vision that Katara is in danger, Aang, Sokka, and Toph all rush back to Ba Sing Se to save her. They meet up with Iroh, who asks their help in saving Zuko who had been captured as well.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Awakening
programme.desc: After sustaining serious injuries at the end of season two, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship. Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Headband
programme.desc: Mistaken for a Fire Nation School student, the disguised Aang is forced to enroll in a Fire nation school. Aang's hair helped to disguise him better with his head band.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Painted Lady
programme.desc: When the gang comes to a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sokka's Master
programme.desc: When Sokka feels he's not contributing enough to the group, he seeks out a mysterious master to teach him the ways of the sword.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Beach
programme.desc: Zuko, Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee go on vacation to Lo and Li's beach house, where they learn much about themselves and each other.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar and The Firelord
programme.desc: Aang and Zuko are taken on parallel adventures that give them insight into their forefathers' pasts - but how does the tale of Roku and Sozin matter to them now?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Runaway
programme.desc: When Toph discovers a quick way to make cash, Katara disapproves, and the rift between them has disastrous consequences.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Puppetmaster
programme.desc: In a Halloween installment, the gang looks into strange disappearances in a spooky town. There, an old lady named Hama teaches Katara some secret Waterbending techniques.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Nightmares and Daydreams
programme.desc: On the eve of the eclipse, Aang's anxiety gets the better of him. His dreams become nightmares, and soon he can no longer tell dream from reality.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Day of Black Sun Part 1: The Invasion
programme.desc: It is the Day of Black Sun and the group meets up with the invasion force."The day has finally arrived and Aang is ready to take on the Fire Lord.
programme.sub-title: The Day of Black Sun Part 1: The Invasion

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Day of Black Sun Part 2: The Eclipse
programme.desc: The eclipse has started and the gang only has a few minutes to get into an underground bunker and find and defeat Ozai.
programme.sub-title: The Day of Black Sun Part 2: The Eclipse

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Western Air Temple
programme.desc: The gang leaves the Fire Nation, humbled and embarrassed by the failure of the invasion. They head to the Western Air Temple.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Firebending Masters
programme.desc: Aang is ready to start his firebending training. However, as Zuko attempts to teach him, he realizes he has lost all his firebending power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 1
programme.desc: Sokka and Zuko break into The Boiling Rock Prison, the Fire Nation's highest security prison, to rescue Hakoda. When they develope an escape plan after finding Hakoda not there, other prisoners get involved and ruin it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 2
programme.desc: This episode is continuing the jailbreak from the previous episode. Sokka, Hakoda, Zuko and Suki form a new escape plan, but it is complicated by the arrival of Princess Azula.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Southern Raiders
programme.desc: Katara and Zuko journey together to find the man responsible for the death of Katara's mother, Kya, who was killed in a Southern Water Tribe raid.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Ember Island Players
programme.desc: The gang goes to the theater to see a play about themselves, but are not happy with the production and the inaccurate portrayals of themselves.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 1: The Phoenix King
programme.desc: Aang finds out that Ozai plans to burn down the Earth Kingdom with an airship fleet. He disappears during the night, having sleepwalked onto a mysterious moving island.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 1: The Phoenix King

programme.title: iCarly: Halvenween
programme.desc: iCarly-slænget holder en "Halfoween"-fest, for de synes, at det skal være Halloween to gange om året. Men da en forklædt gæst snører Carly og vennerne, bliver festen lidt for vild.

programme.title: iCarly: I Kamp med Chip
programme.desc: Et vredt barn ønsker inderligt at hævne sig, men Spencer prøver ihærdigt at stoppe ham. Gibby bliver knust, når hans nye legetøjslaserpistol går i stykker, men bliver himmelhenrykt, når Freddies reparation giver den en overraskende kraft.

programme.title: iCarly: Bandlyst
programme.desc: Da Carly bandlyser T-Bo fra loftet, gør han gengæld ved ikke at lukke Carly ind på Groovy Smoothie. Imens opdager Freddie og Gibby, der er mange fordele ved at være med i et band ... og også et par ulemper.

programme.title: iCarly: Hovedløs i Las Vegas
programme.desc: Da Sam opdager, at hendes mor sidder i fængsel i Las Vegas, beslutter slænget sig for at samle deres mest kostbare ejendele, køre til Vegas og pantsætte deres ting for at få penge til kaution. Gæstestjerner: History Channel's PAWN STARS.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly i knibe
programme.desc: Sams ven kommer ud af ungdomsfængslet, og Sam advarer alle om at holde sig væk, men Carly hører ikke efter og kommer ud på dybt vand. I loftet finder Spencer et par briller med natkikkert.

programme.title: iCarly: Bukseskandalen
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-slænget til at optræde live på sit program i New York. De elsker New York og er vildt glade for at være med i programmet, men alt kan ske i live tv.

programme.title: iCarly: Bukseskandalen (del 2)
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-slænget til at optræde live på sit program i New York, men en stor garderobefejl fra Gibby betyder store problemer for netshowets fremtid.

programme.title: iCarly: Spencers nye venner
programme.desc: iCarly-slænget vil finde venner til Spencer på hans egen alder. De finder nogle gode muligheder, men vil venskaber blomstre?

programme.title: iCarly: Stop tyven!
programme.desc: Da Sams bærbare bliver stjålet, prøver iCarly-slænget at hjælpe hende med at opspore tyven. Imens må Spencer ikke besøge sin yndlingsspillehal, hvis han ikke er i følgeskab med et barn. Hans held vender, når Guppy har brug for en babysitter.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly takker af (del 2)
programme.desc: Carly er parat til at acceptere, at hun ikke skal med til den årlige fest, da hendes far dukker op. Hendes aften tager en uventet drejning, da hendes far stiller hende et livsforandrende spørgsmål.

programme.title: iCarly: En megafed idé
programme.desc: Da frøken Briggs nægter at lade alle Carly og Sams favoritter deltage i talentshowet, beslutter de at være værter for deres dygtige klassekammerater på deres egen onlinewebshow, iCarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Hr. Næsten Perfekt
programme.desc: Carly er lun på Jake, som går på skolen. Han er supercool og ser godt ud. Carly er vild med Jake, så hun inviterer ham til at spille guitar og synge i hendes nye webshow. Hun finder desværre ud af, at Jake er en forfærdelig sanger.

programme.title: iCarly: Kampagne-konkurrencen
programme.desc: Carly og Sam konkurrerer mod Freddie og Spencer om hvem, der kan få flest børn til at se iCarly webcast. Men det stikker helt af, da alle deres planer går grueligt galt.

programme.title: iCarly: En anmelders gunst
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie vil gerne have deres webshow anmeldt af 'Nevelocity', et superpopulært websted, der anmeldelser hjemmesider og webcasts. Da Carly skal møde Nevel finder hun ud af, at han er en irriterende dreng, der gerne vil på date med hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Ude godt, men Spencer er bedst
programme.desc: Carly og Spencers bedstefar kommer på uanmeldt besøg. Han er meget bekymret for, om Spencer er for uansvarlig og skør til at være Carlys værge. Det er op til Carly og hendes venner at overbevise hendes bedstefar om, at Spencer er en ansvarlig værge.
programme.sub-title: Ude godt, men Spencer er bedst

programme.title: iCarly: Rekordforsøget
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver at slå verdensrekorden i den længste, sammenhængende webcast. For at slå rekorden skal iCarly være på i mere end 24 timer i træk.

programme.title: iCarly: En date med Freddie
programme.desc: En iCarly-fan, Valerie, inviterer Freddie på en date. Daten går så godt, at Freddie begynder at filme Valeries eget webshow. Men Freddie føler sig splittet, da Valeries webshow skaber problemer for iCarly-webshowet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kunstneriske kvaler
programme.desc: Carly inviterer Spencers kunsthelt, Harry Joyner, til at kigge på Spencers kunstværker. Da Harry kalder Spencers kunst for amatøragtigt, føler Spencer, at hans liv ikke længere giver mening.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarlys største fan
programme.desc: iCarlys største fan, Mandy, inviteres til at se en livesending af iCarly. Men Mandy viser sig at være mere stalker end fan, så de må gøre alt for at slippe af med hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Rugemor
programme.desc: Carly og Sam forsøger at udklække kyllinger i et naturvidenskabsprojekt. Men æggene klækker tidligere end forventet, og pludselig er der kyllinger overalt i lejligheden! Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer må finde kyllingerne i lejligheden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg gider ikke slås
programme.desc: Carly laver en en unik iCarly T-shirt til Sam for at markere årsdagen for deres venskab. Men da Sam bytter den for koncertbilletter, bliver de to venner uvenner.

programme.title: iCarly: Dansegal
programme.desc: iCarly beder sine fans om at sende videoer ind af dem dem selv, når de danser deres sejeste danse. Over tre tusind danseklip kommer ind, og Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver at holde sig vågne hele natten for at se dem.

programme.title: iCarly: Halloween-forskrækkelser
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie sender iCarly fra en lejlighed, som det siges at spøge i. Da der begynder at ske underlige ting begynder vennerne også at frygte, at spøgelsesrygterne er sande.

programme.title: iCarly: Lad der angres
programme.desc: Spencer redder livet på hovedsangeren i The Plain White T's og får ham til at deltage i iCarly. Mærkelige ting begynder at gå galt midt i Carlys, Sams og Freddies netvideosending.

programme.title: iCarly: Så er der eftersidning
programme.desc: Sam må sidde efter den aften iCarly holder sin 50. netvideosending. Carly og Freddie kan ikke gøre, som de plejer, så de prøver, så godt de kan, at få eftersidning, så de kan sende fra skolebænken med Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi sælger tech-foots!
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie bliver inviteret til Dakas hovedkvarter, der de bliver tilbudt en stor pengesum for at reklamere for Dakas nye sko, Tech-foden, på iCarly. Men det viser sig, at skoene er forfærdelige.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg siger ikke et ord
programme.desc: Carly får en B i historieprøven, hvor hun burde have fået A. Sam, som griber chancen til sit ugentlige møde med rektor Franklin, forandrer Carlys karakter på computeren og overrasker hende med et A.

programme.title: iCarly: TV reddet af iCarly
programme.desc: En kendt producer vil lave iCarly om til et tv-program. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie bliver helt fortvivlede, når de hører om alle de store forandringer, som produceren vil foretage.

programme.title: iCarly: En kæreste for meget
programme.desc: Sam får en kæreste og de to bliver uadskillelige. Men da forholdet begynder at få følger for iCarly, bliver Carly og Freddie klar over, at de må gøre noget.

programme.title: iCarly: Detektivspire
programme.desc: Efter at have set et klip af iCarly, hvor en mand sælger illegale piratvideoer, bestemmer to detektiver sig for at bruge Carly og Spencers loft til overvågning.

programme.title: iCarly: Skoleskift i luften
programme.desc: Carly får at vide, at hun får mulighed for at få et fuldt stipendium til en privat eliteskole pga. netshowet. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i tvivl, men Sam og Freddie ved, at de må få hende til at gå efter det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fægtemesteren
programme.desc: Freddie trænger til lidt mandetid, så han slår sig sammen med Spencer for at træne fægtning. Freddie er et naturtalent, men tingene bliver indviklede, når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mod den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: En date til mig!
programme.desc: Når deres ven Gibby er for genert til at invitere en pige ud, som han kan lide, bestemmer vennerne sig for at få ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" indslag på deres netvideoshow.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så ham først!
programme.desc: Da Carly og Sam viser interesse i den samme fyr, lover de, at han ikke skal komme imellem dem. Men det er svært, og når de kæmper om hans opmærksomhed, bliver deres venskab sat på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Træk i nødbremsen
programme.desc: Carly må træde til, når Spencer bliver afhængig af et videospil. Sam snører Freddie til at tro, at han bliver forfulgt af uheld, når han nægter at sende et kædebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: I dyb gæld
programme.desc: Sam bliver fornærmet, når Freddie beskylder hende for ikke at betale ham og Carly nogle af de penge tilbage, som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver ihærdigt at betale dem tilbage - hun finder ligefrem et job.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts uheldige dag
programme.desc: En 'Dril Lewbert'-sketch går helt skævt og skader Carlys irriterende dørmand. Slænget plejer ham, indtil Freddies mor tager over. Men da kærligheden begynder at blomstre, må de sætte en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Tærtemysteriet
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Spencer tager Freddie med til deres yndlingskonditori, finder de ud af, at forpagteren er død. Men endnu værre er, hans opskrifter er måske gået tabt for evigt.

programme.title: iCarly: En anderledes jul
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at pifte julen op med et utraditionelt træ, kommer Spencer til at sætte ild til alle Carlys gaver. Fortvivlet ønsker hun, at hun havde en normal bror.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Det kosmiske ocean
programme.desc: Padderne rejser gennem en oceanlignende del af rummet.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Trans-dimensionelle padder
programme.desc: Padderne transporteres til en anden dimension, hvor de møder deres 80'er-modstykker i den alternative virkelighed.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Triceratonernes Hævn
programme.desc: Donatello føler sig underlegen over for flugtobotten, men hans intellekt sættes på prøve, da Triceratonerne angriber!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Dreggs ondskab
programme.desc: Raph mister sin kamp-mojo og må overvinde sine følelser for at redde sine brødre fra den visse undergang.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Den evigt brændende ild
programme.desc: Holdet må overvinde umulige odds for at få fat i det sidste stykke af sorthulsgeneratoren.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Det sidste slag om Jorden
programme.desc: Holdet nærmer sig Jorden, og flugtobotten afslører en skrækkelig hemmelighed om sin fortid.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: En by i krig
programme.desc: April består som konoichi og ser en drabelig ny fjende i øjnene, mens padderne støder på nogle gamle, farlige fjender der er vendt tilbage.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: En knækket klan
programme.desc: Leonardo allierer sig i al hemmelighed med Karai og forvilder sig ud i større fare end han kunne have forestillet sig.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Kampen mod insekterne
programme.desc: Holdet kommer op imod Stockman-fluens nye insekthåndlangere, og Raph må mande sig op for at overvinde sin frygt for insekter og lede holdet.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutantbanden

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 306

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 310

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 312
programme.desc: Cathrine på 24 og Kasper på 27 bor i en lejelejlighed i Hornslet på det sydlige Djursland. Sammen har de sønnen Noah på et halvt år. Kasper har lige skiftet job og kender endnu ikke sin nøjagtige løn,

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 402
programme.desc: Shela og Jan har været kærester i snart fire år, og i al den tid de har kendt hinanden, har de levet over evne. De er nu kommet så langt ud, at de ikke har råd til at betale alle deres regninger.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 407

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 408

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Superfansenes observationer skaber ravage i villaen og især Amalie Marias adfærd ryster Kasper dybt. Og så giver Camilla ikke op på sin Rayan og beviser, at alle tricks gælder i krig og kærlighed.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Afgørelsen time – hvem vælger hvem i villaens første pardannelse? Og følelser kommer i spil, når en ny pige træder ind i villaen – hvem fristes til at udfordre deres nuværende forbindelse?

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.desc: Endelig kommer den lille ny Brygge-baby til verden og den nykronede oldemor Ann, skal se baby Alba for allerførste gang.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1605
programme.desc: Stephanie har en overraskelse til Linse, hun synes det er på tide at Linse får lidt styr på sin behåring og har derfor taget Linse med til en brasiliansk voksbehandling.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1112

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 406

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 410

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 502

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 503

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 505

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 506
programme.desc: En gammel fiskemodtagelse på Sandøya skal have en ansigtsløftning, og de vilde kræfter fra Atlanterhavet kommer til at spille en stor rolle.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 508
programme.desc: En gammel folkehøjskolehytte bliver forvandlet til en familiehytte, og aldrig før har teamet foretaget en så drastisk omlægning af grundplanen.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 510

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 601
programme.desc: Halvor, Ole og Gustav tager turen til øen Fårnøtt i Skjeberg, hvor de møder Deborah, Nils og resten af ​​familien – og forvandler en dårligt placeret bjerghytte til et lyst, skandinavisk paradis.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 602

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 603

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1003

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1004

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1005

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1007

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1008

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1104

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1105

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1106

programme.title: Forsidefruer

programme.title: Forsidefruer
